flora: Early Angiosperm Hardwoods (small, primitive woody trees, simple oval leaves with jagged margins)
Inconspicuous primitive flowers (tiny clusters along branches)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; tree profiles are compact and bushy rather than towering; leaves have a slightly thick, waxy, soft-edged look; trunks are smooth with blocky, chunky branch divisions to maintain the toy-like structure.

visual_logic.composition: A sweeping mid-range shot of a small stand of primitive hardwood trees growing along a river bank. Their vibrant green, simple leaf canopies partially overlap, showing glimpses of smooth grey bark.
visual_logic.ground: Moist, dark silt brown earth scattered with fallen simple oval leaves and small clumps of green river moss.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright, warm sunlight cutting through the canopy from a low angle, highlighting leaf surfaces with a clean, waxy reflection.
